decisions.profile_interpretation: owner-specific optimization conclusions are withheld when runtime_or_dependency is the largest self-time owner

decisions.surface_source: this Cartesian XY line_length workload validates edge_fraction and uniform sampling on one line source group; it does not validate RZ revolved_area sampling or justify a realized-surface-table format
